ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white to 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: distal section contains a large contiguous white field; medial section contains a dense cluster of high-contrast black mottling; trailing edge is defined by a solid black band. Right lobe: large triangular white field extending from tip to notch, bordered by a solid black trailing edge with several dark pixel 'fingers' or streaks extending into the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a depth of roughly 10% of the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges are relatively smooth with minor low-amplitude serrations; lateral tips exhibit higher-frequency jagged pixel variations, particularly at the left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature along the lower boundaries of both lobes, tapering to sharpened points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two small, isolated dark circular spots located in the mid-lower quadrant of the left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned dark vertical linear streak (~20 pixels in length) located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, irregular edge at the left distal tip suggesting minor tissue loss; dark linear scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark 'I' shaped vertical pigment bridge located at the junction of the two lobes just below the median notch.
